entities.name: Nylon
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: DuPont's Wallace Carothers created nylon — the first fully synthetic fiber from petroleum. Nylon stockings sold 64 million pairs in the first year (1940). During WWII, nylon was diverted to parachutes, causing a "nylon riot" when stockings returned.
